feedback_text: The checklist says I need proof of treatment, but I cannot tell whether that means the doctor's summary or the invoice.
rationale: Asks which of two documents satisfies a requirement. This is a factual information need without explicit dissatisfaction; the limited uncertainty supports Low severity but no greater impact.

feedback_text: I started a claim but stopped at the paperwork step because I could not work out which forms applied to my case.
rationale: Could not determine which forms applied and explicitly stopped the claim at that step, so an important action is blocked.

feedback_text: My claim says one document is missing without naming it. I cannot complete the request until I know what to provide.
rationale: The missing item is unnamed, and the customer explicitly says the request cannot be completed until it is identified.

feedback_text: It would help to see the required paperwork before starting the claim instead of discovering each item one screen at a time.
rationale: Explicitly proposes showing required paperwork earlier. Discovering items one screen at a time describes limited workflow friction without stated blockage.

feedback_text: I called only to ask which receipt format is accepted. The requirement itself should be clearer online.
rationale: The call is only the channel used to ask which receipt format is accepted; the underlying issue is unclear document requirements.

feedback_text: The upload reached 100%, then the page returned to the empty upload box. I do not know if the file stayed attached.
rationale: The upload reached 100% and then returned to an empty state, leaving unresolved uncertainty about whether the attachment persisted.

feedback_text: The claim still shows 'documents required' even though I uploaded the requested form yesterday.
rationale: The portal still reports documents required after the requested form was uploaded, an inconsistent system state that remains unresolved.

feedback_text: The same medical report has been requested again. It is already listed in my submitted files.
rationale: A report already shown in submitted files is requested again. The inconsistent state supports Technical Issue; the repeated effort also makes Process Friction plausible.

feedback_text: The upload button becomes inactive after I select a file, so I cannot finish submitting the claim.
rationale: The upload control becomes inactive and the customer explicitly cannot finish submitting the claim.

feedback_text: Please add a visible timestamp beside each uploaded document so I can confirm what was sent and when.
rationale: Explicitly requests timestamps for uploaded documents. No current adverse impact or failure is stated.

feedback_text: I am annoyed that the thumbnail is blurry, but the file was accepted and I could continue.
rationale: Reports a blurry thumbnail and annoyance, but the file was accepted and the customer could continue. Emotional wording does not raise severity.

feedback_text: I need to correct the treatment date before submitting, but the review screen sends me back to the beginning.
rationale: Correcting the date sends the customer back to the beginning, creating meaningful repeated workflow effort.

feedback_text: I was able to save a draft and return later with the missing paperwork. That worked well.
rationale: Reports successful draft saving and return to the claim, with an explicit favorable evaluation.

feedback_text: The submit button produced no response, and I cannot tell whether a claim was created.
rationale: The submit control gives no response, so the customer cannot confirm that the important claim-submission action succeeded.

feedback_text: The form accepted a future treatment date without warning me. I noticed it only on the review screen.
rationale: The form accepts an invalid future date without warning, but the customer notices it on review and states no blockage.

feedback_text: I want to submit receipts for several appointments together rather than open a separate claim for each one.
rationale: Explicitly requests combining receipts for several appointments into one claim. No current failure or adverse impact is described.

feedback_text: What does assessment complete mean? The tracker does not say whether payment has been approved.
rationale: Asks for clarification about claim status and payment approval without explicit dissatisfaction. Claim progress is primary, while the payment reference makes Reimbursement plausible.

feedback_text: My email says the claim was approved, while the app still shows it under review.
rationale: Email and app show conflicting claim states, creating ongoing uncertainty about the claim's progress.

feedback_text: The claim disappeared from the tracker after I updated my phone. Support later confirmed it still exists.
rationale: The claim disappeared from the tracker even though support confirmed it still exists. Support is secondary evidence of the tracker problem.

feedback_text: I asked support for an update because the tracker had not changed for more than a week.
rationale: The tracker remained unchanged for more than a week, causing the customer to seek support. The underlying issue is claim progress visibility.

feedback_text: Nothing looks broken; I just want to know how long claims at this stage usually take.
rationale: Explicitly says nothing looks broken and only asks how long this claim stage usually takes. No adverse impact is described.

feedback_text: I received a partial reimbursement but cannot see how the amount was calculated.
rationale: The customer received only part of the reimbursement and cannot see the calculation. The main purpose is explanation, while missing transparency also creates friction.

feedback_text: I am disappointed by the amount, but the calculation is clearly explained and there is no processing problem.
rationale: Expresses disappointment with the amount but explicitly says the calculation is clear and there is no processing problem. Tone alone does not create severity.

feedback_text: The payment failed and the app asks me to contact support without letting me update my account number.
rationale: The payment failed and the customer cannot correct the account number to retry, so the reimbursement process is blocked.

feedback_text: Payment was promised within five days. It has now been twelve days and nothing has arrived.
rationale: Payment is seven days beyond the promised five-day period and has not arrived, an explicit significant ongoing payment problem.

feedback_text: The currency shown on the payment summary is wrong, although the deposited amount is correct.
rationale: The displayed currency is wrong, but the deposited amount is correct. This is a system-display inconsistency with limited stated impact.

feedback_text: Face ID stopped working after the update. I can still sign in with my password.
rationale: Face ID stopped functioning after an update, but password sign-in remains available, limiting the impact.

feedback_text: The sign-in screen keeps refreshing, so I cannot reach my claims.
rationale: The refreshing sign-in screen prevents the customer from reaching claims, explicitly blocking account access.

feedback_text: The password rules appear only after submission. Please show them while I am creating the password.
rationale: Explicitly asks to show password rules earlier. The late rules also create workflow friction, but the requested change is primary.

feedback_text: It is annoying to sign in again, but I was able to continue immediately and nothing was lost.
rationale: Calls repeat sign-in annoying but states continuation was immediate and nothing was lost. The emotional wording does not increase impact.

feedback_text: I can access the website with my details, but the mobile app says the account does not exist.
rationale: Website access works while the app incorrectly says the account does not exist. Mobile access is blocked, but an explicit alternative remains available.

feedback_text: One conversation answered my question and clarified the next steps. I did not need to contact another team or repeat the details, which made the support experience feel coordinated.
rationale: Praises a coordinated support interaction that answered the question without transfers or repeated explanation.

feedback_text: I waited 25 minutes, then the call disconnected before anyone answered.
rationale: After a 25-minute wait, the call disconnected before anyone answered, combining delay with unresolved support access.

feedback_text: I explained the document issue to chat and had to repeat everything after being transferred to a call.
rationale: The customer had to repeat the document issue after a channel transfer; the primary complaint is support handoff friction.

feedback_text: I received different answers from two representatives about whether another form was required.
rationale: Two representatives gave conflicting answers about a form requirement. Inconsistent support is primary, while the subject makes Document Requirements plausible.

feedback_text: The support agent was helpful; the only inconvenience was navigating through several menu options first.
rationale: Explicit praise of the helpful support agent is the dominant purpose. Navigating several menu options is described as the only, secondary inconvenience.

feedback_text: The representative promised a follow-up yesterday, and I have not received it.
rationale: A promised follow-up is overdue and unresolved, which is meaningful ongoing support friction.

feedback_text: My connection dropped on the final step. When I reopened the app, the draft and attachments were still there.
rationale: Factually reports successful recovery after a dropped connection without explicit praise or dissatisfaction. The claim-submission context is a plausible narrower theme.

feedback_text: The instructions are clear overall, but the difference between service date and invoice date could be explained better.
rationale: Evaluates instructions and date terminology within the claim form. The specific claim-submission subject takes precedence over the General Experience fallback theme.

feedback_text: The claim was resolved quickly, but the status notification arrived a day after I saw the change in the app.
rationale: The specific subject is the timing of a claim-status notification. The claim was resolved quickly, but the notification arrived one day after the app changed.
